items.heading: Riz Gras Guineen
details: Key ingredients: rice, palm oil, meat or fish, vegetables
Brown meat or fish with onion in palm oil.
Stir in tomato paste and vegetables, simmering into a sauce.
Add rice and stock, stirring well.
Cover and cook until the rice is tender and richly colored.

items.heading: Foutou with Peanut Sauce
details: Key ingredients: cassava, plantain, peanut paste, meat
Boil cassava and plantain until soft.
Pound them together into a smooth, stretchy dough.
Simmer meat in a peanut sauce until tender.
Serve the pounded dough alongside the peanut sauce.

items.heading: Poulet Yassa
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
